list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM whodunit_sessions WHERE agent <> '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM whodunit_events WHERE agent <> ''

list.name: tz
list.label: Timezone
list.query: +00:00 : UTC, -05:00 : US Central, -08:00 : US Pacific, +05:30 : India, +01:00 : Central Europe

options.content:
## When and how the agent is used
*Working rhythm, tool mix and session shape — from the agent's own session records.*

Modelled on DevLake's **Developer AI Productivity Hours** dashboard, which reads Amazon Q Developer telemetry. This reads whodunit's journal instead, so it works for Claude Code, Codex and `agy` without a vendor API.

**No prompt or response text is recorded anywhere** — whodunit stores counts, file paths and line hashes, never message content. Q Dev's prompt-length panels have no equivalent here, and that is the design, not a gap. Message *volume* is the honest substitute.

Set **Timezone** below to read hours in your own working day rather than UTC.

panels.title: Agent activity by hour of day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LPAD(HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '+00:00', '$tz')),2,'0') AS `hour`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='claude-code' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `claude-code`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='codex' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `codex`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='agy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `agy`
FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.agent IN ($agent)
  AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY `hour` ORDER BY `hour`

panels.description: Stacked by agent. Hours with no bar are hours nobody worked — not missing data.

panels.title: Agent activity by day of week

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '+00:00', '$tz'))
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Sun' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mon' WHEN 3 THEN 'Tue' WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed'
         WHEN 5 THEN 'Thu' WHEN 6 THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END AS `day`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='claude-code' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `claude-code`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='codex' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `codex`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='agy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `agy`
FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.agent IN ($agent)
  AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '+00:00', '$tz')), `day` ORDER BY DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '+00:00', '$tz'))

panels.description: Stacked by agent. A flat weekend is normal; a flat Monday may be worth asking about.

panels.title: Code churn by hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LPAD(HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000), '+00:00', '$tz')),2,'0') AS `hour`,
       SUM(e.lines_added) AS `lines added`,
       SUM(e.lines_removed) AS `lines removed`
FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND e.agent IN ($agent)
GROUP BY `hour` ORDER BY `hour`

panels.description: Volume of change, not value of it. A high-churn hour is a busy hour, not necessarily a productive one.

panels.title: Tools used, by agent

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.tool AS `tool`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='claude-code' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `claude-code`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='codex' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `codex`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.agent='agy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `agy`
FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.tool <> ''
  AND e.agent IN ($agent)
  AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
GROUP BY e.tool ORDER BY `claude-code` DESC

panels.description: Which agent reaches for which tool. Copilot's dashboard cannot ask this — it only knows one tool.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM whodunit_sessions s
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.agent IN ($agent)

panels.title: Tool calls per session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.tool_calls),1) v FROM whodunit_sessions s
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.agent IN ($agent)

panels.description: How much work happens per session, on average.

panels.title: Agent replies per prompt

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.agent_messages)/NULLIF(SUM(s.user_messages),0),1) v
FROM whodunit_sessions s
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description: Message volume only — whodunit never records what was said. A high number means long autonomous stretches per instruction.

panels.title: MCP calls

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(s.mcp_calls) v FROM whodunit_sessions s
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.agent IN ($agent)

panels.description: Calls to connected MCP servers — external tools the agent reached for.

panels.title: Edits applied cleanly

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.outcome='accepted')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) v
FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.outcome <> '' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND e.agent IN ($agent)

panels.description: Share of edits the agent applied without erroring. Not a quality measure — a failed edit is a tool failure, not a bad suggestion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.tool) v FROM whodunit_events e
WHERE e.tool <> '' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND e.agent IN ($agent)

panels.title: How long sessions run

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS `length`, COUNT(*) AS `sessions` FROM (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, FROM_UNIXTIME(first_seen/1000000000), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_seen/1000000000)) < 15 THEN '1. under 15m'
    WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, FROM_UNIXTIME(first_seen/1000000000), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_seen/1000000000)) < 60 THEN '2. 15-60m'
    WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, FROM_UNIXTIME(first_seen/1000000000), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_seen/1000000000)) < 240 THEN '3. 1-4h'
    ELSE '4. over 4h' END AS b
  FROM whodunit_sessions s
  WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.agent IN ($agent)
) t GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

panels.description: Wall-clock first to last event. A session left open overnight inflates this — read it as span, not effort.

panels.title: Work per session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT(s.agent, ' · #', LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.tool_calls DESC), 2, '0')) AS `session`,
       s.tool_calls AS `tool calls`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
WHERE s.tool_calls > 0
  AND s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND s.agent IN ($agent)
ORDER BY s.tool_calls DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Ranked, not identified. The session column in the sidecar still holds the agent's own session id, which on Claude Code is the transcript filename — so it is deliberately not rendered here.

panels.title: Agent comparison

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.agent AS `agent`,
       COALESCE(s.sessions, 0)      AS `sessions`,
       COALESCE(s.tool_calls, 0)    AS `tool calls`,
       COALESCE(e.events, 0)        AS `file edits`,
       COALESCE(e.`lines`, 0)         AS `lines written`,
       COALESCE(c.commits, 0)       AS `commits`
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM whodunit_sessions WHERE agent <> ''
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM whodunit_events WHERE agent <> ''
) a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, COUNT(*) sessions, SUM(tool_calls) tool_calls
  FROM whodunit_sessions
  WHERE last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  GROUP BY agent
) s ON s.agent = a.agent
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, COUNT(*) events, SUM(lines_added + lines_removed) `lines`
  FROM whodunit_events
  WHERE observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  GROUP BY agent
) e ON e.agent = a.agent
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, COUNT(*) commits FROM whodunit_commits
  WHERE agent <> '' AND status = 'assisted'
    AND committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  GROUP BY agent
) c ON c.agent = a.agent
ORDER BY `file edits` DESC, `sessions` DESC

panels.description: Every agent this machine has seen, whether or not it produced anything. An agent with sessions but no edits is running and contributing nothing measurable — worth knowing, and invisible in a merged total.
